visual.general_description: Twelve-lead electrocardiogram printout of the Case 1 patient.
visual.detailed_description: Photographed twelve-lead electrocardiogram on pink grid paper with a faint shadow across the centre. Lead labels I, II and III run down the left column, aVR, aVL and aVF down the second column, V1, V2 and V3 down the third and V4, V5 and V6 down the right, with a longer bottom strip labelled II. A rectangular calibration pulse starts each row on the left, and dotted vertical lines separate the column groups. Complexes are regularly spaced. In the V1, V2 and V3 columns the complexes have very deep downward deflections reaching far below the baseline, followed by upright rounded waves, while the V4, V5 and V6 columns show smaller downward and upward deflections. The limb-lead rows show small deflections, with downward complexes in aVR and aVL. No text other than lead labels is visible and no measurement values are printed.

visual.detailed_description: Two photographed ultrasound screens side by side, labelled A and B. Panel A is a photographed ultrasound screen. At the top is a small fan-shaped sector image with a narrow colour box containing blue and red pixels, a colour scale bar at the far left and a column of setting text at the left (including "Echo Boost 1" and "iTouch+"). A box at the upper right shows a numbered line with Chinese characters and "364.65 cm/s" and a second line with Chinese characters and "53.19 mmHg". Below, a continuous-wave Doppler spectral display marked "CW" shows five repeating wedge-shaped orange, yellow and pink envelopes hanging down from the top baseline against a dark purple speckled background, with a scale of ticks labelled 1 to 4 at the right edge ending "m/s". Panel B is a photographed ultrasound screen showing a grayscale apical view with a fan-shaped sector, depth ticks labelled 0, 5, 10 and 15 along the right side and a small "m" marker at the top. A trapezoid colour box in the left-centre holds a blue, orange and red mosaic area on the grayscale image. A box at the lower right prints "1 LAA(A4C) 6.24 cm²" and "2 LA Vol(A2C) 8.15 ml".

Panel C is a grayscale axial chest slice in a lung window: a bright chest wall ring and white central mediastinum, dark grey lung fields with fine branching bright vessels on both sides and a small dark oval airway lumen near the centre in front of the spine.
